mods.name: TNT Arsenal
mods.description: Sixty kinds of TNT, each with its own hand-drawn look and its own way of going off: earthquakes that tear fissures down to bedrock, volcanoes, black holes, meteors, drills, tunnels, spiral staircases, bunkers, towers, bridges, x-ray, harvesters, lumberjacks, wolf packs and more. Plus a nuclear arsenal: mini nuke, nuke and tsar bomba with a remote detonator, a mushroom cloud, radiation in chunks and players, fallout, contaminated water and a Geiger counter. Bedrock, obsidian and chests are never touched. Crafted at the table, so JEI and REI show every recipe.
